subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should the first publisher-wide workflow install skills only, or wait until plugins have a first-class installation contract?
rationale: Skills have an established installer with moderation, overwrite, lockfile, and version behavior, while plugin packages currently stop at artifact download and verification; combining them commits the product to a new plugin lifecycle and consent model.

options.title: Start With Skills
options.body: Add publisher-wide skill installation that preserves every per-item check and defer plugins until their installation lifecycle is defined.

options.title: Design Both Together
options.body: Define plugin installation, compatibility, consent, rollback, and partial-failure behavior before exposing any publisher-wide command.

options.title: Discovery Only
options.body: List all publisher artifacts and generate individual commands without performing bulk mutation.

recommendation.title: Start With Skills
recommendation.body: Add publisher-wide skill installation that preserves every per-item check and defer plugins until their installation lifecycle is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current install path, adjacent command-namespace proposal, and this product request.
